item.title: Yvonne ‘Bonnie’ Krok
item.description: Yvonne Louise “Bonnie” Krok, 75, Bremen, died at 7:04 p.m. Wednesday, Dec. 17, 2025, at Signature Health Care Bremen. She was born on July 9, 1950, in Chicago. She is survived by her son, Thomas Krok, South Bend. Mishler Funeral Home, Bremen, is handling arrangements.

item.title: Fire Crews still at scene of Nelson Drive house fire
item.description: Tankers from Milford, Leesburg and Turkey Creek Fire Territory continued shuttling water to the scene of a house fire at 128 E. Nelson Drive, just south of Milford, an hour after the fire was reported.
